arguments.question: Assess the macro channels most material to ANET over 5, 21 and 63 completed sessions: discount-rate/long-duration valuation sensitivity, hyperscaler and enterprise capital-spending/order timing, and whether broad risk appetite/credit conditions provide a competing explanation for recent strength. Use current dated Fed/rate evidence plus SPY, XLK, IWM and HYG observations; distinguish observed conditions from conditional mechanisms. Deliver decision boundaries showing what rate, capex or risk-regime changes would strengthen or weaken the ANET thesis. Stop after one current primary monetary-policy source and the supplied market context; do not infer company-specific demand from macro proxies.
arguments.decision_impact: Tests whether valuation-duration and order-cycle risks could dominate company fundamentals over the requested weeks-to-months horizon.
